name: Molech
overview: Molech, also known as Moloch or Milcom, was an idol worshiped by the Ammonites and is specifically condemned in Scripture for the abhorrent practice of child sacrifice. The Lord commands Israel not to give their offspring to Molech, warning that such acts defile His sanctuary and profane His holy name, with severe penalties prescribed for those who engage in this idolatry (Leviticus 18:21; 20:2-5). Notably, even King Solomon fell into this sin by allowing his foreign wives to lead him into worshiping Molech, demonstrating the persistent danger of compromising faithfulness to God through idolatry (1 Kings 11:1).
